title: “Even now,” declares the Lord,
paragraphs:
“Even now,” declares the Lord,
“return to Me with all your heart.” — Joel 2:12

God did not say return when life is perfect.
He said return now.

Return from pride.
Return from compromise.
Return from spiritual sleep.
No matter how far someone has drifted, the voice of God still calls.

Judgment warns us.
Mercy invites us.
And the door of repentance is still open.

If God is calling you back today…
will you listen?
